At work, as a cloud architect, I’m good at solving complex problems, but I constantly miss deadlines because I can’t organize my tasks. Emails pile up, and I jump between tasks without finishing any. The depression feels new, but the chaos in my head has always been there.

The trouble concentrating didn’t come first—it started after I stopped caring, after the sadness settled in. Before all this, I managed my work just fine. I know something’s wrong, but it feels like the fog won’t lift.
